subject: Latest Linux build is causing a "Incomplete block on file" error during installation, is this my fault or is the build a problem?

messages.author: 4808110ed3760d39
messages.subject: Latest Linux build is causing a "Incomplete block on file" error during installation, is this my fault or is the build a problem?
parts:
I tried to execute this command on my Linux ec2 instance:

install.packages("http://inla.r-inla-download.org/Linux-builds/CentOS%20Linux-7%20(Core)/Current/64bit.tgz",repos=NULL, method="libcurl")

That failed:

Installing package into ‘/home/ec2-user/R/x86_64-koji-linux-gnu-library/3.4’

(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)

trying URL 'http://inla.r-inla-download.org/Linux-builds/CentOS%20Linux-7%20(Core)/Current/64bit.tgz'

Content type 'application/x-tar' length 2548355 bytes (2.4 MB)

==================================================

downloaded 2.4 MB


Error in untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) : 

  incomplete block on file

Warning message:

In install.packages("http://inla.r-inla-download.org/Linux-builds/CentOS%20Linux-7%20(Core)/Current/64bit.tgz",  :

  installation of package ‘/tmp/RtmpvK8ESH/downloaded_packages/64bit.tgz’ had non-zero exit status


That failed. I also attempt to install the previous version and that failed for different reasons:

Installing package into ‘/home/ec2-user/R/x86_64-koji-linux-gnu-library/3.4’

(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)

trying URL 'http://inla.r-inla-download.org/Linux-builds/CentOS%20Linux-7%20(Core)/Version_18.05.28/64bit.tgz'

Content type 'application/x-tar' length 40673446 bytes (38.8 MB)

==================================================

downloaded 38.8 MB


ERROR: cannot extract package from ‘/tmp/RtmpvK8ESH/downloaded_packages/64bit.tgz’

Warning message:

In install.packages("http://inla.r-inla-download.org/Linux-builds/CentOS%20Linux-7%20(Core)/Version_18.05.28/64bit.tgz",  :

  installation of package ‘/tmp/RtmpvK8ESH/downloaded_packages/64bit.tgz’ had non-zero exit status

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Latest Linux build is causing a "Incomplete block on file" error during installation, is this my fault or is the build a problem?
parts:
ooops, this not a package. it only contains the binaries. I added an
HOWTO earlier today, maybe that one will help:

http://inla.r-inla-download.org/Linux-builds/HOWTO

H
